title: Track witness and constant dependencies before specialization
obstacle: A chosen witness or constant may depend on data that the target requires it to be independent of.
procedure: Record the order in which parameters and witnesses are chosen.
Prove the quantified statement before substituting special values.
Inspect each specialization and the exported signature for additional dependencies.
verification: Compare the complete binder order and dependency graph with the target.
positive_example: Choose a witness after the variables on which it is allowed to depend.
negative_example: Promote a family of parameter-dependent constants to one universal constant.

evidence.note: Editorially generalized guidance under this maintenance policy; no independent effectiveness result or proof acceptance is claimed.
